mission.outcome: Land HMS Ambush research mission: empirically test whether Method 3 (1D heat-equation inverse problem) can extrapolate x_core past the probe tip on the existing real CSVs, characterise its parameter confidence (Hessian + bootstrap), and quantify robustness under sigma=0.5/1.0/2.0 deg C noise. Output is a research report with a clear go/no-go recommendation; no production wiring.
